name: dumbbell pronated grip row
description: A bent-over row with an overhand grip, building the muscles of the mid and upper back.
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand and hinge forward with a flat back.
Let your arms hang with palms facing your legs.
Pull the dumbbells up toward your lower ribs.
Keep your elbows close to your body and squeeze your shoulder blades.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.
